# Austria

> Benchmark chips for Austria cut from the harmonized field boundary collection for Austria (edition 2025).

- [Collection](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/at/collection.json)
- [README](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/at/README.md)
- [Agent guide](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/at/AGENTS.md)
- [Field boundary lines](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/at/at_boundary_lines.parquet)
- [Chip definitions with field coverage](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/at/at_chips.parquet)
- [Chips (PMTiles)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/at/chips.pmtiles)
- [Field boundary polygons](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/at/at_fields.parquet)
- [Field polygons after the class filter](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/at/at_fields_filtered.parquet)
- [Field boundaries (PMTiles)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/at/fields.pmtiles)
- [STAC items in GeoParquet format (collection mirror)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/at/items.parquet)
